body.name: simultaneous welfare--divergence tube
body.construction: Use the conditional quantile \(\widehat q_{1-\alpha}\) of the shared multiplier supremum and fixed slack \(\eta\) to form \(\widehat{\mathcal T}_n=\{(c,w,k):|w-\widehat W(\widehat\theta_c)|\le s_W(c)(\widehat q_{1-\alpha}+\eta)/\sqrt n,\ |k-\widehat K(\widehat\theta_c)|\le s_K(c)(\widehat q_{1-\alpha}+\eta)/\sqrt n\}\).
